interpretation: Public GIS object33 supplies the G19 footprint, 5-floor field and building-height field19.32m. No absolute roof RL, datum, point cloud or component-height breakdown is provided. The 19.32m field constrains the reconstructed canopy maximum above its retained OSM/DEM foundation; this derived roof elevation is not a surveyed RL. The source footprint includes a central covered passage; occupied hall partition and south hall are fitted with original routes kept clear. Original OSM north-wing / canopy outlines and raw tags are retained independently.

architect.observed: Architect describes sandstone podium, aluminium-clad raised boxes with continuous east/west louvres, central open passage, laminated jarrah tree supports, steel and glass.

photographs.observed: Displayed main front photograph inspected: butterfly canopy, branching timber, two screened halls and sandstone podium.
Full 1280px source photo inspected: three branching tree supports in depth, steep glass wings, metal purlins, podium bands, open central slot, bridges and stairs.
Full source photo inspected: southern long screened box on stone podium, slim lower columns and dark glazed opening, three shallow steps.
Full architect sketch inspected: two halls either side of open central canopy, stepped approach and terraces.

streetView.observed: Verified native panorama inspected facing Scientia: two banded sandstone walls with horizontal louvres, open central stair slot, branching jarrah canopy, stair landing, central metal handrail and sloped planted edges. Historical condition, no measured component dimensions.

aerial.observed: Native aerial inspected: long northern roof with solar panels, narrow central roof slot, detached southern hall roof beside Civil Engineering and surrounding lawn / paths. University GIS supplies the footprint; aerial is context, not a measured height or material survey.

estimates: Canopy valley and support levels, component cladding divisions, southern hall partition, small projection depths and colours remain photo-led estimates. No source pixels redistributed; occupied interiors are closed. Central passage paving follows terrain below unchanged source stair treads. Two overhead links and the northern roof solar-panel layout are fitted from gallery/aerial context; exact counts, arrangement, bridge levels and present operation are unverified.
